200.description: One page of the product's pack levels.

level.description: A packaging level, lowest first. Receiving and picking flows of consumers implement EACH and CASE in v1.
level.title: PackLevel

gtin.description: A GTIN, always the 14-digit zero-left-padded string with a valid mod-10 check digit.
gtin.title: Gtin14

childGtin.description: A GTIN, always the 14-digit zero-left-padded string with a valid mod-10 check digit.
childGtin.title: Gtin14

unitsPerPack.description: The direct factor to eaches (1 for EACH).

active.description: False once the level is end-dated.

effectiveTo.description: Present once the level is end-dated.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

400.description:
A paging or filter error of a collection GET: `limit` not an integer
from 1 to 500 (`invalid-limit`), a `cursor` that is not a page token
(`invalid-cursor`), a query parameter the operation does not declare
(`unknown-query-parameter`), a `classified` that is not `true`/`false`
or an unknown `handlingTag` (`malformed-request`), or an invalid SKU
(`invalid-sku`, pack levels).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
